input.query: local file driver upload image returns file path

candidates.explanation: The stored path is built as `/${apiPrefix}/v1/${file.filename}`. It leaves out the `files` segment. The download route is `GET /{apiPrefix}/v1/files/:path`, from `@Controller({path:'files', version:'1'})`. The returned link is backendDomain + path, so it points to /api/v1/<name> and returns 404, even though the file is on disk in ./files.

fix.description: Include the files controller segment in the stored path: `/${apiPrefix}/v1/files/${file.filename}`.
